rules: n, k_bitlen, and e_bitlen are JSON integers, never booleans
all tuple and reduced numerator/denominator values are canonical decimal integer strings
digest is lowercase SHA-256 of canonical sorted compact ASCII tuple JSON
fails is sorted, unique, and contains only K1 and K2
K2 in fails requires K1 in fails
failure extras are present exactly when fails is nonempty
e, q_den, f_den, and tuple D/E are strictly positive canonical strings
schema validation never decides whether an inequality actually fails

forbidden: generator, verifier, checkpoint, shard, or aggregate orchestration
ownership_boundary.execution: Controller invokes every later stage CLI and independently checks outputs; candidate probes, booleans, and status strings are never evidence.
